context: M25 o2. Midtown Central, front desk, near midnight. Kearney opens his bottom drawer.

lines.speaker: char.pat_kearney
lines.text: Arce. Sit. Not there, that's evidence. There.

lines.speaker: char.pat_kearney
lines.text: Christmas list. Sixty-nine, seventy, seventy-one. Who paid. Who collected.

lines.speaker: char.pat_kearney
lines.text: Took a turkey every year. Never a dollar. Kept the list. Never knew why.

lines.speaker: char.pat_kearney
lines.text: Now I know. Take it before I retire and somebody cleans this desk.

lines.speaker: char.pat_kearney
lines.text: Don't thank me. Mayhew's car is on Thirty-Fifth. Go finish it.
